info.title: usalvo - run a Postman collection's requests in parallel.
info.description: Run a Postman collection's requests in parallel and print a compact pass/fail summary.

options.name: --token
options.description: Bearer token (or env PM_TOKEN). Prompted if omitted.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Postman environment JSON file (reads its values[] array).

options.name: --globals
options.description: Postman globals JSON file (reads its values[] array).

options.name: --workers
options.description: Max concurrent requests. Must be 1 or greater. Default 50.

options.name: --burst
options.description:
Fire all requests at once. Ignores --workers.
Warning: large collections may exhaust ephemeral ports.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output results as JSON to stdout (suppresses console table).

options.name: --iterations
options.description: Run the collection N times and report aggregated results. Default 1.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
VARIABLE PRECEDENCE (highest wins)
--var / --baseurl  >  PM_* env  >  --environment  >  --globals  >  collection variable[]
